what_i_see: A well-constructed chess king piece in isometric view. It has a wide circular base, a tapered cylindrical stem, a disc collar, a spherical head, and a cross on top made from small boxes. The proportions are accurate and the stacking of geometric primitives (cylinders, spheres, boxes) convincingly recreates the classic king silhouette. Clean white/gray shading against a dark background with clear outlines.
